## Common WHERE Filters

### Partition Filters (Always Required)

```sql
WHERE grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### Standard Filters (Present in ~90% of queries)

```sql
  AND target_type = 'item'
  AND user_id > 0
```

### Platform Filter (Mobile only)

```sql
  AND platform in ('ios_app', 'android_app')
```

### Search Traffic Filter

```sql
  AND step1_feature_detail in ('global_search-item', 'search_in_pdp-item', 'search_in_subcategory-item', 'search_in_mall-item', 'search-item')
```

### Discovery / Recommendation Traffic Filter

```sql
  AND step1_feature_group in ('Similar Products', 'You May Also Like', 'Daily Discover')
```

### Region Filter (Standard 8 Regions)

```sql
  AND grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
```

### Extended Region Filter (Including LatAm)

```sql
  AND grass_region in ('TW','MY','PH','SG','TH','ID','VN','BR','MX','CO','CL')
```

### AB Test Exclude Filter

```sql
  AND get_full_signature_udf(split(ab_test, '@')[1]) != 'DS2'
```

### Exclude Game Pages

```sql
  AND page_type not in ('game_candy_grocery_store', 'fruit_store')
```

### Impression Non-zero Filter

```sql
  AND impress_cnt_direct_lead > 0
```

### Organic Only Filter

```sql
  AND coalesce(
    cast(json_extract_scalar(json_extract_scalar(step1_data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads') as varchar),
    cast(json_extract_scalar(step1_data, '$.is_ads') as varchar),
    'false'
  ) = 'false'
```

### Location Range Filter

```sql
  AND coalesce(cast(json_extract_scalar(step1_data, '$.location') as int), -1) >= 0
  AND location <= 300
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN with Ads Slot Mapping (Search + Discovery)

```sql
left join mp_paidads.ads_slot_mapping
on bi_imp.grass_region = ads_slot_mapping.grass_region
  and bi_imp.location = ads_slot_mapping.location
```

### JOIN with Item Dimension Table

```sql
left join mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live
on imp.grass_region = dim_item.grass_region
  and imp.item_id = dim_item.item_id
```

### Self JOIN for BI vs Ads Tracking Comparison

```sql
left join bi_tracking
on ads_tracking.search_request_id = bi_tracking.request_id
```

### JOIN Impressions with Orders

```sql
left join (
    select grass_region, user_id, sum(place_order_cnt_direct_lead) as order_cnt
    from mp_foa.dwd_eventid_item_order_events_di__reg_s0_live
    where ...
    group by grass_region, user_id
) orders
on imp.grass_region = orders.grass_region
  and imp.user_id = orders.user_id
```

### JOIN with Exchange Rate

```sql
left join (
    select grass_region, exchange_rate
    from mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
    where grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
      and grass_region = upper('${region}')
) exchange_rate
on a.grass_region = exchange_rate.grass_region
```

### JOIN Impression with Click Events for Fill Rate

```sql
left join ads_click
on ads_fill_rate.grass_region = ads_click.grass_region
  and ads_fill_rate.user_id = ads_click.user_id
  and ads_fill_rate.keyword = ads_click.keyword
  and ads_fill_rate.req_type = ads_click.req_type
```

## Common Aggregations

### Total Impression (Primary Metric)

```sql
sum(impress_cnt_direct_lead) as imp_cnt
```

### Search-Only Impressions

```sql
sum(case when step1_feature_group = 'Search' then impress_cnt_direct_lead end) as search_imp_cnt
```

### Ads Impressions (after parsing is_ads flag)

```sql
sum(case when is_ads = 'true' then impress_cnt_direct_lead else 0 end) as ads_imp
```

### Ads-in-Adslot Impressions

```sql
sum(case when is_ads = 'true' and is_ads_slot = 1 then impress_cnt_direct_lead else 0 end) as ads_imp_in_adslot
```

### Adslot Impressions (organic + ads in ad slots)

```sql
sum(case when is_ads_slot = 1 then impress_cnt_direct_lead else 0 end) as ads_slot_imp
```

### Ads Outside Adslot

```sql
sum(case when is_ads = 'true' and is_ads_slot = 0 then impress_cnt_direct_lead else 0 end) as ads_imp_outside_adslot
```

### Unique Request Count (Search Volume)

```sql
count(distinct request_id) as search_volume
```

### Requests with Ads

```sql
count(distinct case when ads_imp > 0 then request_id else null end) as req_w_ads_imp_cnt
```

### Organic-only Impression by Item

```sql
sum(impress_cnt_direct_lead) as org_impression_1d
-- with WHERE is_ads = 'false'
```

### User-Level Impression

```sql
grass_region, user_id,
sum(impress_cnt_direct_lead) as impr_cnt
group by 1, 2
```

### Entry Point + is_ads Aggregation

```sql
group by grass_region, entry_point, is_ads, user_id, ab_sign
```

### Page Section PV

```sql
group by page_section, grass_date, grass_region
```

### Snippet 1: Keyword Fill Rate (Search Ads)

```sql
-- Extract BI impression data for search keyword fill rate analysis
-- Source: fill_rate workflow
cache table bi_imp OPTIONS ('storageLevel' 'MEMORY_AND_DISK')
select  grass_region
        ,user_id
        ,get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data, '$.search_FE.search_params'), '$.keyword') as keyword
        ,coalesce(
            get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads'),
            get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.search_params.search_info'), '$.is_ads'),
            'false'
        ) as is_ads
        ,cast(get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.search_params'), '$.location') as int) as location
        ,get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data, '$.search_info'), '$.request_id') as request_id
        ,impress_cnt_direct_lead
from    mp_foa.dwd_eventid_impress_di__reg_s0_live
where   grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
  and   grass_region = upper('${region}')
  and   platform in ('ios_app', 'android_app')
  and   step1_feature_detail in ('global_search-item','search_in_pdp-item','search_in_subcategory-item')
  and   get_full_signature_udf(split(ab_test, '@')[1]) != 'DS2'
  and   target_type = 'item'
  and   user_id > 0
```

### Snippet 2: Discovery Ads Impression Data

```sql
-- Extract impression data for discovery/recommendation traffic
-- Source: discovery_ads scheduled_tasks
insert into dev_mkplpaidads_discovery_ads.total_product_and_ads_imp_data
select  grass_date
        ,grass_region
        ,step1_feature_group as entry_point
        ,user_id
        ,regexp_extract(cast(json_extract_scalar(step1_data, '$.recommendation_info') as varchar), 'AB:(.*?),', 1) as ab_sign
        ,coalesce(
            cast(json_extract_scalar(json_extract_scalar(step1_data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads') as varchar),
            cast(json_extract_scalar(step1_data, '$.is_ads') as varchar),
            'false'
        ) as is_ads
        ,coalesce(cast(json_extract_scalar(step1_data, '$.location') as int), -1) as location
        ,sum(impress_cnt_direct_lead) as impress_cnt_direct_lead
from    mp_foa.dwd_eventid_impress_di__reg_s0_live
where   tz_type = 'local'
  and   grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
  and   grass_date = date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '-1d')}')
  and   target_type = 'item'
  and   user_id > 0
  and   platform is not null
  and   step1_feature_group in ('Similar Products', 'You May Also Like', 'Daily Discover')
  and   coalesce(cast(json_extract_scalar(step1_data, '$.location') as int), -1) >= 0
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
```

### Snippet 4: Organic Item Impression for Item Performance

```sql
-- Aggregate organic impressions per item (excluding ads)
-- Source: dws_item_1d workflow (deprecated)
cache table item_org_imp AS
select
    grass_region,
    grass_date,
    item_id,
    case when
        cast(get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property,'$.common_params'),'$.is_ads') as string) is not null
        then cast(get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property,'$.common_params'),'$.is_ads') as string)
        when regexp_extract(cast(get_json_object(step1_data_property,'$.search_params.search_info') as string), '.*is_ads":([a-zA-Z]*).*', 1) is not null
        then regexp_extract(cast(get_json_object(step1_data_property,'$.search_params.search_info') as string), '.*is_ads":([a-zA-Z]*).*', 1)
        else 'false' end as is_ads,
    sum(impress_cnt_direct_lead) as org_impression_1d
from mp_foa.dwd_eventid_impress_di__reg_s0_live
where tz_type = '${tz_type}'
  and target_type = 'item'
  and grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  and grass_region = upper('${region}')
  and user_id > 0
group by 1,2,3,4
```

### Snippet 6: Traffic Group Analysis (Ads Params)

```sql
-- Build traffic group categorized impression data
-- Source: ads_advertise_params workflow
create or replace temporary view oa_imp as
select  step1_data_property
        ,step1_feature_detail
        ,step1_feature_group
        ,step1_feature
        ,user_id
        ,item_id
        ,platform
        ,device_id
        ,ab_test
        ,grass_date
        ,grass_region
from    mp_foa.dwd_eventid_impress_di__reg_s0_live
where   grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  and   grass_region = upper('${region}')
  and   tz_type = 'local'
  and   (
            step1_feature_group IN ('You May Also Like', 'Similar Products', 'Daily Discover')
        or  (step1_feature_group IN ('Search') and step1_feature = 'global_search')
        or  (step1_feature_group in ('Cart Recommendation', 'Order Successful Recommendation'))
        or  (step1_feature_group = 'Rcmd Others' and step1_feature in ('My Purchase Page YMAL', 'Order Detail Page YMAL'))
        )
  and   platform IN ('ios_app', 'android_app')
  and   user_id > 0
  and   item_id > 0
```

### Snippet 7: Monthly Entry Point Distribution with Item Price

```sql
-- Analyze impression distribution across entry points with item price
-- Source: manual_tasks/shijing
with imp_base as (
    select
        a.grass_region,
        date_trunc('month',a.grass_date) as g_month,
        case
            when (step1_feature_detail='fruit_store-product_section-item' or page_type = 'fruit_store') then 'Fruit Game'
            when page_type = 'game_candy_grocery_store' then 'Candy'
            when step1_feature_group = 'Search' and step1_feature_detail in ('global_search-item', 'search_in_pdp-item', 'search_in_subcategory-item', 'search_in_mall-item','search-item') then 'Search'
            when step1_feature_group = 'Search' and step1_feature_detail in ('image_search-item','image_search-original_item-item','image_search-rcmd-item','image_search-search-item') then 'Image Search'
            when step1_feature_group = 'Search' then 'Search Others'
            when step1_feature_group = 'Rcmd Others' and step1_feature_detail = 'order_list-you_may_also_like-item' then 'My Purchase Page Recommendation'
            when step1_feature_group = 'Rcmd Others' and step1_feature_detail = 'order_detail-you_may_also_like-item' then 'Order Detail Page Recommendation'
            else step1_feature_group
        end as entry_point,
        coalesce(cast(json_extract(json_extract(step1_data_property,'$.common_params'),'$.is_ads') as varchar), regexp_extract(cast(json_extract(step1_data_property,'$.search_params.search_info') as varchar), '.*is_ads":([a-zA-Z]*).*', 1), 'false') as is_ads,
        item_id,
        sum(impress_cnt_direct_lead) as imp_cnt
    from mp_foa.dwd_eventid_impress_di__reg_s0_live as a
    where a.tz_type = 'local'
      and a.target_type = 'item'
      and a.grass_date between date'2023-10-01' and date'2023-10-27'
      and a.grass_region = 'ID'
      and a.page_type not in ('game_candy_grocery_store', 'fruit_store')
      and a.user_id > 0
      and impress_cnt_direct_lead > 0
    group by 1,2,3,4,5
)
```

### Snippet 8: Ads Penetration Rate by Region

```sql
-- Compute requests with ads / total requests
-- Source: manual_tasks/jian.cao/debug
with t1 as (
    select  *
            ,coalesce(
                get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads'),
                get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.search_params.search_info'), '$.is_ads'),
                'false'
            ) as is_ads
            ,cast(get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.search_params'), '$.location') as int) as location
    from    mp_foa.dwd_eventid_impress_di__reg_s0_live
    where   target_type = 'item'
      and   tz_type = 'local'
      and   user_id > 0
      and   platform in ('ios_app', 'android_app')
      and   grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
      and   grass_date = '2023-05-29'
      and   step1_feature_detail in ('global_search-item')
)
,t2 as (
    select  grass_region
            ,get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.search_params.search_info'), '$.request_id') as request_id
            ,sum(case when is_ads = 'true' then impress_cnt_direct_lead else 0 end) as ads_imp
    from    t1
    where   location >= 0 and location <= 100
    group by 1, 2
)
select  grass_region
        ,count(distinct request_id) as num_req
        ,count(distinct case when ads_imp > 0 then request_id else null end) as num_req_w_ads
from    t2
group by 1
order by 1
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

### 1. is_ads Flag (extracted from JSON)

Appears in 15+ files. Two extraction paths depending on traffic type:

```sql
coalesce(
    get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.common_params'), '$.is_ads'),
    get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.search_params.search_info'), '$.is_ads'),
    'false'
) as is_ads
```

### 2. Search Keyword Extraction

Appears in 8+ files.

```sql
get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data, '$.search_FE.search_params'), '$.keyword') as keyword
```

### 3. Request ID Extraction

Appears in 8+ files. Two variants:

```sql
-- Search traffic
get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data, '$.search_info'), '$.request_id') as request_id

-- Discovery traffic
regexp_extract(cast(json_extract_scalar(step1_data_property, '$.rcmd_params.recommendation_info') as varchar), 'REQID:(.*?),', 1) as request_id
```

### 4. Fill Rate

Appears in 3+ files. Derived from impressions grouped into adslot buckets:

```sql
-- Request-level fill rate
sum(case when is_ads = 'true' and is_ads_slot = 1 then impress_cnt_direct_lead else 0 end) * 1.0
  / sum(case when is_ads_slot = 1 then impress_cnt_direct_lead else 0 end) as fill_rate
```

### 5. Location Extraction

Appears in 6+ files.

```sql
cast(get_json_object(get_json_object(step1_data_property, '$.search_params'), '$.location') as int) as location
```

### 6. AB Sign from Recommendation Info (Discovery)

Appears in 3+ files.

```sql
regexp_extract(cast(json_extract_scalar(step1_data, '$.recommendation_info') as varchar), 'AB:(.*?),', 1) as ab_sign
```

### 7. Entry Point Classification Mapping

Appears in 3+ files. Maps step1_feature_group/detail to business-readable entry point names:

```sql
case
    when step1_feature_group in ('Similar Products', 'You May Also Like', 'Daily Discover', 'Cart Recommendation', 'Order Successful Recommendation', 'Rcmd Others') then 'rcmd'
    else 'search'
end as traffic_type
```

### 8. Ads Per Request Ratio (Penetration)

```sql
req_w_ads_imp_cnt * 1.00 / search_volume as req_w_ads_imp_pct
```

### 9. Item + Shop ID Extraction

Appears in 5+ files.

```sql
-- Item ID
cast(coalesce(get_json_object(step1_data,'$.itemid'), get_json_object(step1_data,'$.item.itemid')) as bigint) as item_id
-- Shop ID
cast(coalesce(get_json_object(step1_data,'$.shopid'), get_json_object(step1_data,'$.item.shopid')) as bigint) as shop_id
```
